name: Woods
description: Temperate forest. Adds production, slows movement, and can be chopped for a one-off yield.

name: Rainforest
description: Dense tropical growth. Feeds a city but chokes its Appeal.

name: Marsh
description: Waterlogged ground. Extra food, poor Appeal, and blocks most improvements until drained.

name: Floodplains
description: Silt deposited by a river. Exceptional food at the price of periodic flooding.

name: Oasis
description: Fresh water in the deep desert. Cannot be removed, and supplies Housing like a river.

name: Reef
description: Coral shelf. Rich fishing and a major Campus adjacency source.

name: Ice
description: Pack ice. Impassable to anything without an icebreaker.

name: Geothermal Fissure
description: A vent of volcanic heat. Major adjacency for a Campus, and later a power source.
